name: upwork
description: Connect to Upwork through its official MCP server.

research.notes: Upwork's official remote MCP (registry com.upwork.mcp/upwork-mcp, listed in Anthropic's directory) covers job search, proposals, messages, contracts and dashboards for freelancers and clients; upwork.com docs and help pages were blocked by a Cloudflare challenge, so the client list and pricing come from the directory and registry. Discovery 2026-10-09: authorization server mcp.upwork.com advertises CIMD yes and a registration_endpoint that points at the www.upwork.com/register sign-up page (DCR unconfirmed), S256.

probe.reason: HTTP 401, sign-in methods and S256 PKCE confirmed; no account tested
